Proposition
[left translations are isometries]

Source: petersen:page-0155 ↗ def:pet-ch4-left-invariant-metric-lie

With the metric of subsection 4.1, $L_g$ is a Riemannian isometry for every $g\in G$.
Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch4-left-translation-isometry

\sketch The metric at $h$ is the pushforward of the fixed inner product at $e$ by $(DL_h)_e$. Since $L_g\circ L_h=L_{gh}$, the differential $(DL_g)_h$ carries this pushforward to the one defining the metric at $gh$; it is therefore an isometry at every $h$.

□
